lessons.nctb_title_bn: বর্ণ শিখি : চ ছ জ ঝ ঞ

blocks.text_bn:
পাঠ ২০
বর্ণ শিখি : চ ছ জ ঝ ঞ

চক	চ
ছন	ছ
জগ	জ
ঝড়	ঝ
মিঞ	ঞ

চক দিয়ে লেখা পড়ি।
ছন দিয়ে ঘর গড়ি।
জগ থেকে জল ঢালো।
ঝড় আসে মেঘ কালো।
মিঞ মিঞ ডেকে যায়
বিড়ালটা আঙিনায়।

দাদু চশমা পরেন।
নৌকার ওপর ছই থাকে।
জল পড়ে পাতা নড়ে।
ঝরনা থেকে পানি পড়ে।
মিঞ সাহেব ছাতা মাথায় দিয়ে চলেন।

image_slots.compliance_note: NCTB p29 shows an elderly man holding an umbrella (adult male figure: C-05 + C-02 dress). REFRAMED per dress rule: single adult male with FULL BEARD, modest full-length clothing (full-sleeve, hem below ankle) and cap, holding an umbrella overhead, walking; no bare skin beyond face/hands; no other people. Incidental adult male ('মিঞ সাহেব'), not a cast child. Stripe lands on plain ground clear of face/hands and umbrella; high-contrast line-art for B/W.
image_slots.prompt: A gentle children's-textbook illustration of a single adult man with a full beard, wearing modest full-length clothing (a long full-sleeve garment reaching below the ankles) and a cap, holding an umbrella over his head as he walks calmly. Plain white background, soft watercolour style, clean bold outlines. No bare skin beyond face and hands, no other people. High contrast for black-and-white photocopy.

lessons.notes: পাঠ ২০ বর্ণ-শিখি: চ ছ জ ঝ ঞ (🔒 স্থির, pages 28–29). User: KEEP AS-IS, ONLY REPLACE IMAGES. ALL TEXT RETAINED VERBATIM (spotlight চক/ছন/জগ/ঝড়/মিঞ; both sentence sets incl. 'দাদু চশমা পরেন', 'মিঞ সাহেব ছাতা মাথায় দিয়ে চলেন') → action=retain-curated is IMAGE-ONLY. All words oral:true named examples → letter-audit EXEMPT; only decodable content = letters চ-ঞ (b10/b12), NCTB-original → exempt. IMAGE CURATION (targeted): already-clean objects/scenery kept object-only (ছন house, জগ, ঝড় scene, চশমা, ছই, জল, ঝরনা); মিঞ/বিড়াল = single-animal stripe. TWO figure fixes: (1) চক — NCTB HAND writing on blackboard (hand = living-being body part, C-05) → object-only blackboard 'চ' + chalk (no hand); (2) মিঞ সাহেব — NCTB elderly man + umbrella (adult male, C-05/C-02) → REFRAMED per dress rule: adult male with FULL BEARD + modest full-length dress (hem below ankle) + cap, umbrella, single figure, stripe. Word note: মিঞ/মিঞা সাহেব = respectful address ('gentleman/mister'), neutral, kept. c_codes C-05/C-02/C-06. Tracing = vector_asset, prompt='' permanently. Ready to merge after পাঠ ১৯.
